# AI Commerce Store - LLM Access Guide

## Scope
This website provides machine-readable product, pricing, inventory, shipping, and policy data for AI agents.

## Preferred Endpoints (v1)
- GET /api/v1/products/search
- GET /api/v1/products/{sku_id}
- POST /api/v1/products/batch
- GET /api/v1/compare?sku=SKU1,SKU2
- POST /api/v1/cart/add
- POST /api/v1/order/preview
- POST /api/v1/order/submit

## Query Rules
- Use cursor pagination (`next_cursor`) for large result sets.
- Prefer structured filters over keyword-only search.
- Respect rate limits and retry with backoff on 429.

## Purchase Safety
- Never call order/submit without explicit human confirmation code.
- Always surface total cost, return policy, and warranty before confirmation.

## Data Freshness
- Check `meta.generated_at` and `updated_at` on product objects.
- Treat stale inventory as uncertain.

## Contact
- support@yourstore.com
